title: Understanding the Model Equation
text: The model equation given is $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 critic_1$$. This means that the predicted $$self_{rating}$$ is a linear combination of a constant term $$\theta_0$$ and the $$critic_1$$ rating multiplied by $$\theta_1$$.

title: Effect of Squaring $$critic_1$$
text: If you use the square of $$critic_1$$ as the predictor variable, the equation becomes $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 {critic_1}^2$$. Consider how this change affects the relationship between $$critic_1$$ and $$self_{rating}$$.

title: Impact on $$\theta_1$$
text: Does using $${critic_1}^2$$ instead of $$critic_1$$ change the value of $$\theta_1$$ in the model equation?
